extraction.Name: Ellen Prue Packard
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded February 23, 1918 by the Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: conveyed by deed signed by Ellen Prue Packard and Harry Packard to Joseph M. Bartlett for a consideration of $7600.00, assumed and agreed to pay as part of the purchase price
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612727 issued; northwest quarter of section 13, township 98, range 79; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 8, 1918; land mortgaged February 21, 1918 for $1600.00; again February 25, 1919 for $2800.00; land conveyed May 19, 1919; sale subject to a mortgage of $2800.00 which Bartlett assumed and agreed to pay as part of the purchase price; Harry Packard also signed the deed
